Residents:

Office: All spots empty.

Notes:
Weekend routine: Both home 00:00–16:00. At 16:00, both phones were removed from the house (likely for evening errands or socializing), as they were not found in any room at that patrol. By 19:44, Aisha’s headphones moved from bed to desk. Kitchen items (bowls, mugs, plates) cycle between cupboard/sink and table/dish rack during meal prep/cleanup. Work items (laptops, chargers, headphones) are typically on the bedroom desk during the day, moving to the bed or nightstand in the evening. Aisha’s and Felix’s skincare moved from the medicine cabinet to the bathroom shelf at 16:00. Aisha’s backpack moved from the hook to the entry floor at 16:00. The board game was moved from the coffee table to the bookshelf at 00:00.
